CONTACT US

LIFE IS A HIGHWAY
DENVER PHOTO BOOTH BUS

When you live in Colorful Colorado, you have to expect the unexpected. After all, there’s a reason we have the saying, “If you don’t like the weather, just wait five minutes.”

​

In addition to some of the most beautiful landscapes in the world, we have some of the world’s craziest weather. Which can make event planning just slightly…difficult. Sure, your weather app may say that it’s going to be 90 degrees with only a 40% chance of snow, but how can you be sure?

​

And do you really want to wager the success of your event on something outside of your control? Of course not. That’s why we usually have fallback plans. Indoor locations. Or canopies with customized hand warmers at the very least.

​

When you’re planning your event, you want to leave nothing to chance.

And that includes your photo booth.

VW BUS PHOTO BOOTH

 A show-stopping photo experience like no other.

CONTACT US

INTRODUCING THE LIFE OF THE PARTY

Hi! We’re MiHi Photo Booth. We’ve been voted Denver’s Best Photo Booth Service.

​

Why? Because we love what we do.

​

And what we do is help make sure you have the best darn party possible.
We’re constantly heading back to the lab to shift your fun into overdrive.

We have unique photo booths. We have tons of props. We have pose flash cards.

​

And now we have a VW Bus photo booth.

GET PRICING NOW

MEET OUR PHOTO BUS!

We took a VW Bus, restored it, and converted the inside into a mobile photo booth.

​

It has all the bells and whistles of a regular photo booth, except it’s a ‘73 out of 10 on the awesome scale. A little bit quirky. A little bit classy. A whole lot of fun!

​

It’s completely enclosed. So none of that pesky weather can get in and ruin your fun. And if you have to use your indoor location, we can follow you inside.

Nothing grabs attention quite like having a big, beautiful blue photo booth bus set up inside of your building. That’s kinda the point, right? To have the best party possible. To make the most memories. To have the most fun. Both inside and outside of the booth.

​

With MiHi and our Photo Booth Bus, you’ll cruising in no time!

VW BUS PHOTO BOOTH FEATURES

If having a VW Bus boosting the vibe at your event isn’t enough, check out the following reasons why you should strap in with our Photo bus:

​

Fun props.

What’s a photo booth without props? Dull. That’s what it is.

​

Unlimited Sessions.

Don’t stress about the perfect shot! Just get posing!

​

Two Prints Per Session.

The basic package comes with two prints to share the fun!

​

Customized Photo Strips.

No matter your event, we can create an amazing border!

​

Online Gallery.

After your event, head to our website to download your photos.

​

Additional Time.

Your party is a smash! Let us know if you rent more time.

​

Idle Time.

Special idle rates for those times you need to shut down the booth. Like speeches. Or a demolition derby. Just leave our photo bus out of it!

​

Digital Sharing.

Share your photos directly to your phone or social media!

​

Social Media Kiosk.

For those extra-large parties! Photos get sent to the kiosk where you can share them directly on social media. Ask about branding opportunities for corporate events!

​

Unlimited Prints.

For those times when you need more than 2 prints. Make sure everyone in the shot gets a keepsake.

​

Additional Photo Filters.

When your photos need a little bit more pizazz. 16 filters in all. Ranging from black and white to sepia, to comic books, and more!

​

Memory Book.

We’ll print an extra photo that will be placed in a beautiful memory book that your guests can sign. This isn’t some dollar-store scrapbook. This is a high-quality, padded memory book with slots for the photos and a designated space for your guests to write. This is the kind of book you’d find on an episode of Pawn Stars.
